objective: Test whether a defined Wyckoff context plus a defined lower-timeframe imbalance trigger improves expectancy.

composition.wyckoff_role: Defines range context, phase hypothesis, and directional invalidation.
composition.ict_role: Defines only the lower-timeframe liquidity sweep, displacement, and three-candle imbalance trigger.
composition.conflict_rule: No trade when the Wyckoff context and lower-timeframe trigger disagree.

requirements: A Wyckoff range and phase hypothesis exist before examining the trigger timeframe.
The external liquidity reference is marked before it is swept.
Displacement uses the numeric body-to-median definition.
Imbalance uses the numeric three-candle gap definition.
Entry, stop, target, invalidation, and news proximity are recorded before entry.
exclusions: Either methodology is being added after the outcome is visible.
The setup qualifies under only one half of the combined definition.
A term cannot be mapped to an observable or numeric condition.
Risk or planned reward-to-risk requirements are not met.
